description: 1,166 mapped and classified aquifers, with material, productivity, vulnerability and demand ratings. Published by Watershed Stewardship and Security (Province of British Columbia) as [Ground Water Aquifers](https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/dataset/ground-water-aquifers) in the BC Data Catalogue; this is a full province-wide mirror. Query recipes and field notes are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

table:columns.name: GW_A_SYSID
table:columns.description: GW_A_SYSID is a system generated unique identification number

table:columns.name: AQUIFER_ID
table:columns.description: System generated sequential number assigned to the aquifer. It is widely used by ground water administration staff as it is the only consistent unique identifier for a mapped aquifer. It is also commonly referred to as Aquifer Number, e.g. 1100.

table:columns.name: NAME
table:columns.description: Name assigned for a specific aquifer. Typically derived from geographic names or names in common use, but may also be lithologic or litho-stratigraphic units, e.g. Abbotsford-Sumas, McDougall Creek Deltaic.

table:columns.name: MAPPING_YEAR
table:columns.description: The year the aquifer was initially mapped or last updated.

table:columns.name: LOCATION
table:columns.description: Brief description of the geographic location of the aquifer. The description is usually referenced to a nearby major natural geographic area or community, e.g., Grand Forks.

table:columns.name: MATERIAL
table:columns.description: Describes the broad grouping of geological material found in the aquifer, i.e., Sand and Gravel, Sand, Gravel, Bedrock

table:columns.name: SUBTYPE
table:columns.description: Description that defines how the aquifer was formed geologically (depositional description), e.g., Unconfined sand and gravel - large river system, Confined sand and gravel - glacial, Flat-lying to gently-dipping volcanic bedrock.

table:columns.name: AQUIFER_DETAILS_URL
table:columns.description: Link to aquifer summary report within the Groundwater Wells and Aquifer (GWELLS) application. The aquifer summary provides the overall desription and history of the aquifer.

table:columns.name: LITHO_STRATOGRAPHIC_UNIT
table:columns.description: Permeable geologic unit (where available) that comprises the aquifer. It is typically either: the era of deposition, the name of a specific formation, and/or the broad material types, e.g., Paleozoic to Mesozoic Era, Cache Creek Complex, Intrusive Rock.

table:columns.name: VULNERABILITY
table:columns.description: The aquifer's relative intrinsic vulnerability to impacts from human activities on the land surface. Vulnerability is based on: the type, thickness, and extent of geologic materials above the aquifer, depth to water table (or to top of confined aquifer), and type of aquifer materials, i.e., Low, Moderate, High.

table:columns.name: PRODUCTIVITY
table:columns.description: The aquifer's productivity which represents an aquifer's ability to transmit and yield groundwater, i.e., Low, Moderate, High.

table:columns.name: DEMAND
table:columns.description: The level of groundwater use at the time the aquifer was mapped, i.e., High, Moderate, Low.

table:columns.name: WATER_USE
table:columns.description: The type of known water use of an aquifer at the time the aquifer was mapped. It indicates the variability or diversity of uses of the aquifer water as a supply source, e.g., Domestic, Multiple, Potential Domestic.

table:columns.name: QUALITY_CONCERN
table:columns.description: Standard terms used to represent the extent of documented concerns of contaminants in the aquifer at the time the aquifer was mapped. i.e. isolated, local, regional, none.

table:columns.name: NOTES
table:columns.description: Details about the mapped aquifer that the province deems important to maintain such as local knowledge about the aquifer or decisions for changes related to attributes of the mapped aquifer.

table:columns.name: FEATURE_AREA_SQM
table:columns.description: FEATURE_AREA_SQM is the system calculated area of a two-dimensional polygon in square meters.

table:columns.name: FEATURE_LENGTH_M
table:columns.description: FEATURE_LENGTH_M is the system calculated length or perimeter of a geometry in meters.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: OBJECTID is a column required by spatial layers that interact with ESRI ArcSDE. It is populated with unique values automatically by SDE.

table:columns.name: SE_ANNO_CAD_DATA
table:columns.description: SE_ANNO_CAD_DATA is a binary column used by spatial tools to store annotation, curve features and CAD data when using the SDO_GEOMETRY storage data type.

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float not null, ymin: float not null, xmax: float not null, ymax: float not null>
